psychological_meaning: True V evokes feelings of creativity, sophistication, and calm. It is often associated with imagination, wisdom, and spirituality, promoting a sense of inner peace and introspection. This color can inspire artistic expression and innovative thinking, while also providing a sense of stability and harmony.
